agent_instructions.role: You are a Senior Android Engineer. Build ZipMaster: ZipMaster opens and creates ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, and GZ archives directly on your Android phone. Browse archive contents, extract files, and create new ZIPs without a PC.
agent_instructions.design_philosophy: Premium, fast, and minimal. This is a utility app — performance is the feature. Users should feel instant response on every tap.
code_standards: Jetpack Compose for all UI with Material Design 3.
Room database for history, bookmarks, recent files.
Hilt for dependency injection throughout all layers.
Google Play Billing 6.x for Pro subscription.
Foreground Service for long-running media/conversion operations.

core_dependencies.archive_engine: org.apache.commons:commons-compress:1.25.0 for ZIP/TAR/GZ + junrar library for RAR support

ui_ux_design.design_notes: Dark mode is primary for media apps. Light mode available. Large touch targets for playback controls.

execution_steps.step_1: Setup project with Hilt, Room, Navigation Compose. Configure core engine dependency.

execution_steps.step_2: Implement file picker with Storage Access Framework (SAF) and recent files tracking.

execution_steps.step_3: Build core viewer/player screen with gesture controls and zoom/seek.

execution_steps.step_4: Add settings screen: theme, default behavior, quality options.

execution_steps.step_6: Build home screen with recent files grid and folder browser.

execution_steps.step_7: Add any cloud integration (Google Drive, Dropbox) via their SDKs.

execution_steps.step_8: Integrate Google Play Billing for Pro tier, add AdMob for free tier.
